Click to expand...

How much RAM do you consider "low DRAM"?

The package above appears to be the higher end "AMD Halo" competitor version of Razor Lake with a 256-bit bus (4 chips). There should be 128-bit versions as well (i.e. Razor Lake-U, Razor Lake-H, etc). that only need 2 chips.. i.e. 16GB base very likely.

Also worth noting -- Wildcat Lake ("cut down" Panther Lake) has a 64-bit wide bus, though I'm not sure if any "on package memory" versions of Wildcat Lake refresh or successors are coming.
